IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on State Government Operations & Accountability (originally sponsored by Representatives Nixon and Talcott)

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the periodic increment date for state employees returning to work after military service.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to state employees; and adding a new section tochapter 41.06 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: State employees called to active duty with any branch of the UnitedStates military shall return to work with credit for the periodicincrement date for that time served on active military duty. Forpurposes of this section, "periodic increment date" has the samemeaning as defined in WAC 357-28-050 as it exists on the effective dateof this section.
